description: Completed an intensive program covering the full app lifecycle—from UI/UX design and prototyping to native (Swift/Kotlin) and cross‑platform (React Native) implementation. Built and shipped multiple hands‑on projects integrating RESTful APIs, state management, and Git‑based collaboration, while applying Agile best practices for testing and deployment.

Built hardware and software skills by programming microcontrollers in C++ with Git version control, writing and testing RESTful APIs, and setting up CI/CD pipelines. Worked on an IoT capstone project, followed Agile sprints and code reviews, and honed problem‑solving through end‑to‑end software development coursework.
